visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and bangs is wearing a dark purple t-shirt. She holds a large LEGO Ideas Mineral Collection box (set 21362) in front of her face, playfully moving it around. Behind her is a tall black glass display cabinet filled with numerous anime and superhero figurines. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from the side. (2) Close-up shot of the LEGO box being unboxed. A hand presses down on the perforated cardboard tabs to open the side. The surface below is a white kitchen countertop. (3) A white cat with a pink collar walks across a light wood floor towards a white circular rug with black decorative script. (4) Hands are pulling out white paper bags containing LEGO bricks from the box. Multiple manuals for set 21362 are displayed on the counter. (5) A man with a buzzed haircut, wearing a grey sleeveless shirt, is seated at a table. He is focused on assembling small, colorful, translucent LEGO pieces. The camera zooms in on the scattered bricks on the table. (6) The woman's hand holds a finished LEGO mineral model (Fluorite) next to a real purple mineral specimen for comparison. (7) An orange tabby cat sniffs the real mineral specimen held by the woman. (8) Successive close-up shots show different completed LEGO minerals: a blue and purple octahedron, an orange and yellow crystal pillar, a cluster of red cubic crystals on a black base, and a purple geode. (9) All five completed LEGO mineral models are displayed together on a table next to a stack of books titled 'CATS'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a high-pitched, energetic female voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin over a light, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM. Short, percussive 'pop' SFX are heard as titles appear visually. (2) A sharp 'thud' and tearing sound of cardboard trigger a phase shift as the unboxing begins; the female voice continues with a curious tone. (3) The acoustic BGM maintains a steady, moderate tempo. The sound of plastic bags rustling and paper manuals being flipped creates a textured mid-range layer. (4) A male voice enters with a calm, lower pitch, engaging in a playful banter with the female speaker. There are frequent 'clicks' of LEGO bricks snapping together. (5) A distinctive 'whoosh' transition sound effects a shift to the comparison phase. The BGM remains consistent, but the vocal intensity rises as the speakers express excitement ('Woah!'). (6) The video concludes with a more cinematic, swelling orchestral-pop finish to the BGM as the final product is showcased, accompanied by a final energetic vocal phrase from the woman.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Unboxing -> Assembly -> Final Showcase
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the unboxing, assembly process, and final aesthetic quality of the LEGO Ideas Mineral Collection (21362), highlighting its realism through comparison with actual minerals.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video focuses entirely on the LEGO set, displaying the box, model number, and assembly process prominently.
